title: September–December 2026 – Total closures to traffic (Mont Blanc Tunnel)
claims: No extended autumn closure of the kind carried out in 2023, 2024 and 2025 is planned for 2026.
From mid-September onwards, numerous midweek night-time closures are scheduled from Monday to Thursday, each lasting 8 hours from 22:00 to 06:00, with two exceptions lasting 11 or 12 hours.
The schedule of night-time closures is still under review by the Prefecture and will be published on the operator's website and the TMB Mobility app once approved.
